digest: CostHealth’s Stage 3 features appear implemented and marked complete, but release readiness is not independently confirmed because the full verification environment was unavailable and the repository contains substantial noise.

CostHealth’s Stage 3 capability appears substantially implemented, but release readiness remains unconfirmed because the work is largely uncommitted and current end-to-end verification has not been reproduced. The immediate need is independent technical criticism to separate verified product state from historical claims and prioritize the material risks before any further implementation.

CostHealth appears substantially built through Stage 3, but release readiness is still unconfirmed and the work remains exposed to repository and verification risks. The next step is an independent technical review to establish what is truly verified and what must be remediated before advancing.
